name: Fairmont The Queen Elizabeth Hotel
positioning: Fairmont The Queen Elizabeth, a downtown Montreal hotel above Central Station, open since 1958
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Montreal base with direct access to Central Station
Guests who want a spa, indoor pool and 24-hour fitness centre in the city

facts.text: The hotel is directly above Montreal's Central Station in downtown Montreal.

The hotel has direct access to Central Station, and attractions such as the Bell Center, Sainte-Catherine Street, Old Montreal, the Museum of Fine Arts and the Quartier des Spectacles are within reach.
The hotel has been an icon of downtown Montreal since 1958.
Dining includes Rosélys restaurant, Nacarat for cocktails and Marché Artisans for local products.
Rosélys serves a Sunday brunch buffet.
The hotel has an indoor pool, a hot tub and saunas.
The Wellness Center fitness facility is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Fairmont Gold rooms and suites on floors 18-19 include lounge access with deluxe continental breakfast and cocktail hour hors d'oeuvres.

highlights.text: Guests can book the very room where John Lennon and Yoko Ono stayed for their Bed-In.
In 2017 the classic 1960s hotel was renovated by the agency Sid Lee, which created new gathering spaces.
Locals often walk through the hotel lobby, and the bar and restaurant are popular after-work hangouts.
The Deluxe 2 Queens room is described as ideal for families.

considerations.text: Parking is available at an additional fee, indoor with valet service.
Montreal-Trudeau International Airport is the nearest airport, 20 minutes away by car.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury downtown properties.
